name: xpath-functions-fn
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLSetContext d namespace {{nsprefix:"fn", nsurl:"http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions"}}
try
XMLXPath r with "fn:upper-case(string(book[1]/title))"
end try
try
XMLXPath r with "fn:lower-case('ABC')"
end try
try
XMLXPath r with "fn:compare('a', 'b')"
end try
try
XMLXPath r with "fn:compare('b', 'b')"
end try
try
XMLXPath r with "fn:ends-with('abc', 'bc')"
end try
try
XMLXPath r with "fn:base-uri(book[1])"
end try
try
XMLXPath r with "fn:upper-case()"
end try
XMLClose d

set r to XMLRoot d
set l to XMLXPath r with "//title/text()"
writetext "\"Moby-Dick\" = \"Moby Dick (fr)\";" to (POSIX file "$TMP/l.strings")
XMLLocalize l using (POSIX file "$TMP/l.strings")
XMLGetText l
XMLClose d

name: xpath-localize-element
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set b to XMLChild r index 1
writetext "\"%1$sMoby-Dick%2$s%3$sHerman Melville%4$s%5$s1851%6$s%7$s9.99%8$s\" = \"%3$sHM%4$s%1$sMD%2$s%7$s1%8$s%5$s2%6$s\";" to (POSIX file "$TMP/e.strings")
XMLLocalize b using (POSIX file "$TMP/e.strings")
XMLDisplayXML b
XMLClose d

name: xpath-strings-nested
script: set d to XMLOpen from string "xyzw" set r to XMLRoot d XMLStrings r XMLClose d
